starfall-crossing: A welcoming sunlit hilltop observatory town built around a shattered celestial stone lens; honey-colored plaster and oak guild buildings, teal copper domes, arched terrace bridges, distant green valleys. Golden afternoon.
rustcoil-outpost: A welcoming brass-and-timber repair outpost beside retired colossal machinery; a copper gear-clock tower, little workshop roofs, orderly hanging crane booms, teal patina and distant dusty mesas. Clear amber morning.
cinder-refuge: A sheltered settlement inside the mouth of an immense volcanic basalt overhang, warm clay ovens and fabric awnings around a communal orange hearth, distant vents across a cooled lava valley. Warm protective lamplight against violet ash twilight.
frostfen-camp: A quiet expedition camp of steep blue timber lodges and fur-trimmed canvas shelters at the edge of a frozen reed marsh, a tall signal beacon, distant white hills and pink dawn reflected in thin ice. Welcoming amber windows.
stormbreak-haven: A sheltered cliffside port above a rolling cloud sea, sturdy windbreak towers and blue pennants, bronze storm masts, rope rigging and a distant skybridge. Late afternoon peach sunbeams through soft slate clouds.
astral-observatory: A magical hilltop scholar town of elegant cream-stone observatories, floating brass star lenses, crescent terraces and glowing azure windows under an indigo starry sky. A huge slow aurora and distant violet hills; intimate warm lantern pools.
greenroot-meadow: An open lush meadow route with white wildflowers, low mossy ruins, a fractured old stone bridge crossing a blue stream, scattered turquoise starstones and a far abandoned observatory. Fresh golden morning and layered blue-green hills.
thornpath-thicket: A dense but readable woodland route winding beneath ancient intertwined canopy trees, curled thorn vines, a split standing-stone relay with soft teal crystal lights, hanging amber seedpods and a distant forest opening. Dappled warm light.
bramble-depths: A cavernous ancient root dungeon beneath a forest, vast interwoven roots arching over a sealed root gate, pockets of moss and soft teal fungi, broken stone shrines disappearing into deep green haze. Sparse amber shafts from above.
rustcoil-ruins: An abandoned open-air celestial machine complex half swallowed by grass, giant broken brass orrery rings, rusted copper wheels, blue ceramic conduits and sandstone arcades. Clear pale sunlight and distant ocher hills; strange soft teal energy.
gearworks-vault: The grand interior of an ancient mechanical vault, huge interlocking bronze gear housings, a monumental circular vault lock, thick riveted beams and orderly machinery receding into blue depth. Warm furnace-lit brass against cool shadows.
cinder-hollow: A wide volcanic hollow with rounded black basalt shelves and gentle glowing ember vents, red-orange light within cracks, sparse hardy gold grasses and a distant crooked chimney spire. Smoky mauve atmosphere, warm soft glow.
emberjaw-lair: A volcanic cavern shaped by a sleeping ancient fire guardian, a monumental jagged magma gate resembling a broad stone jaw, warm lava channels far below, hanging obsidian formations and red-orange light fading into purple haze.
bandit-ridge-camp: A rugged autumn ridge hideout built from mismatched wooden watchtowers, canvas canopies and hanging rope walkways, supply barrels well back from foreground, a narrow lookout platform overlooking golden wooded foothills. Late golden sun.
oreback-quarry: A stepped pale sandstone quarry with turquoise ore seams, enormous wooden lift wheels, old mining carts on distant rails and a broad central excavation reaching into mist. Warm dusty sunlight with crisp cream and copper rocks.
ashglass-pass: A windswept high pass filled with translucent dark amber and smoky blue volcanic glass formations, one delicate ancient glass-and-stone bridge spanning a distant ravine, sparse ash bushes and layered copper mountains. Low golden sidelight.
frostfen-outskirts: A broad frozen wetland dotted with bent reeds, icy willow trees and snow-capped stone marker piles, a winding ribbon of blue ice disappearing through low mist. Pale peach morning, cold lavender shadows and distant glacier wall.
glacier-spine: A dramatic glacial mountain ridge with huge sweeping blue ice fins like a dragon spine, narrow frozen waterfalls and a distant suspension bridge, crisp crystalline edges nearby and soft white mountain peaks beyond. Rose-gold high-altitude daylight.
rimewarden-sanctum: A solemn circular ice temple interior carved into a glacier, pale stone columns encased in translucent blue frost, a large snowflake seal above distant steps, frozen hanging bells and delicate blue luminous crystals. Warm light through one high opening.
stormbreak-cliffs: Tall weather-worn sea cliffs above clouds, carved stone wind rods, small mossy ledges, a far monumental natural arch and graceful pennants showing strong wind. Sunlit cream cliff edges and storm-blue distant sky with golden breaks.
astral-archive: A vast open magical library hall with curving ivory bookshelves, floating lanterns and orbiting brass celestial instruments, a deep blue star window and long receding aisles. Warm parchment surfaces against soft violet atmospheric depth.
eclipse-frontier: An uncanny frontier at the boundary of daylight and a gentle cosmic eclipse, broken dark-violet monuments, a distant monumental crescent gate, silver grasses and floating stone shards against a luminous lavender horizon. Thin warm gold rimlight.
endless-rift: An immense otherworldly rift with layered floating stone islands and a huge luminous fractured circular lens suspended in the distance, delicate teal and violet cosmic ribbons and scattered warm golden embers. Quiet open space with crisp nearby rock shapes.
brambleking-court: A royal forest arena inside the hollow of an enormous ancient tree, a throne-like crown of twisting roots in the background, golden leaves, carved stone steps and soft jade luminous fungi. Symmetrical solemn warm forest light, clear open foreground.
titan-foundry: A colossal abandoned construct forge with a giant humanoid-shaped assembly cradle far behind the playfield, suspended bronze anvils, articulated crane arms and furnace windows. Warm amber metal highlights and cool blue workshop haze.
deepcore-core: The heart of an underground crystalline quarry, an immense multifaceted turquoise geode core embedded in cream rock, stout stone supports and suspended mining lifts, deep mineral layers sparkling softly. Warm amber lamps against sea-green crystal light.
emberjaw-furnace: A grand volcanic furnace arena with a huge dragon-jaw stone kiln in the distance, circular black basalt ribs, broad orange glowing channels and hanging iron chains well behind the foreground. Bold warm firelight with smoky violet distance.
rimewarden-vault: A hidden frozen treasure vault with nested translucent blue ice arches, a monumental circular frost lock, orderly carved stone plinths and white frost patterns. Soft peach light from above and clear pale cyan depth, empty foreground.
stormbreak-aerie: An enormous mountaintop bird aerie formed from smooth pale stone arches and woven golden branches, storm masts around a distant nest dais, endless rolling cloud sea below and blue mountains far beyond. Dramatic golden cloud-break light.
astral-stacks: A secret mirrored library vault with towering tiered scroll stacks, slender glowing cyan ladders, suspended brass moon globes and star-filled ceiling openings. Ivory stone, honey-colored parchment, deep violet atmospheric perspective.
eclipse-throne: A regal cosmic observatory throne chamber open to a total solar eclipse, one elegant black stone throne beneath an enormous gold ring, deep violet banners and pale celestial stone terraces. Gold corona rimlight, restrained lilac stars, clear foreground.
guardian-trial: A serene fortress training courtyard with broad cream stone walls, a large shield-shaped monument, orderly upright practice shields along the distant wall and blue hanging pennants. Morning gold sunlight, soft distant hills, an empty testing ground.
berserker-trial: A rugged arena hewn into warm red canyon walls, broken stone training pillars and heavy chains mounted far behind the playfield, a monumental rough iron gate. Bold sunset orange light, dusty atmospheric layers, an empty testing ground.
duelist-trial: An elegant open-air dueling terrace of pale stone beside an autumn garden, slender arches, two crossed practice blades mounted high on the back wall, red silk ribbons and distant mountain ridges. Warm late-morning light, empty arena.
fire-mage-trial: An arcane kiln courtyard with circular terracotta braziers, distant towers topped with softly glowing fire crystals and a great sun medallion in the rear arch. Warm cream masonry and deep coral ember light, an empty clear testing ground.
rune-mage-trial: An ancient magical study arena inside a roofless circular stone sanctuary, floating geometric rune stones with no readable lettering, pale turquoise crystals and softly glowing concentric stone rings. Gentle warm daylight and blue depth, empty foreground.
storm-mage-trial: A high exposed training platform amid pale clouds, slender copper lightning conductors, storm-glass orbs and a distant arched thunder gate, flowing blue ribbons. Golden sun breaks through slate clouds, an empty testing ground.
sniper-trial: A quiet long-range archery training valley with distant circular straw targets at different depths, weathered wooden observation platforms and a broken stone viaduct among golden pines. Clear crisp morning, blue distant ridges, empty foreground.
trapper-trial: A woodland tracking course with carefully spaced fallen logs, rope pulley training devices well back from the playfield, small watch huts and layered fern-covered roots. Dappled warm forest light, no characters or dangerous real traps, empty foreground.
beast-archer-trial: A peaceful ancient animal-warden sanctuary with carved stag and bird stone totems, graceful rooted arches, wildflower patches and a distant waterfall among golden-green trees. Gentle luminous forest morning, empty testing ground without animals.
shop-weapon-interior: A welcoming weapon smith workshop: warm oak ceiling beams, honey plaster and slate masonry, organized wall-mounted swords and a few bows, a small enclosed unlit forge hearth at far right with soft amber residual light, a broad workbench against the rear wall with one anvil and tidy tool pegs. Copper and dark iron accents. Functional, sturdy, capable craftsmanship. Keep the middle lower wall visually simple.
shop-armor-interior: A welcoming armor outfitter: strong oak beams and warm cream stone, a few empty plate breastplates and round shields visibly mounted flat against the high rear wall, folded cloth and leather rolls on side shelves, a tailoring bench at far right, a small helm display near the upper left. Brass, desaturated blue cloth and polished steel. No humanoid mannequins. Calm lower central wall, no counter blocking the actors.
shop-supply-interior: A cozy supply apothecary: warm honey plaster and oak framing, tidy side cabinets of a few broad colored medicine bottles, rolled travel blankets, leather packs, a hanging bundle of dried herbs high at one side, a small mortar on a rear side table. Mint glass and warm terracotta accents, no bright magic glow. Make medicine and adventuring supplies immediately recognizable, with uncluttered lower middle wall.
shop-special-interior: A scholarly star-magic boutique: warm ivory stone and walnut beams, rear side bookcases with a few large leather spellbooks, one elegant brass armillary sphere on an upper rear shelf, small restrained pearl-blue crystals inside a side display cabinet, deep desaturated blue fabric behind a high crescent ornament. Inviting magical curio room, not a throne or combat arena. No floating platforms or dramatic aura. Clear lower central wall.
